rows.summary: loader loads core; core waits for decrypted .text, checks every hook signature, disables features whose hooks fail
rows.test: log: 'hook ok <id>' for every hook

rows.summary: ImGui on the game's D3D11 swapchain; Remnant theme for Remnant screens, MHW theme for HUD; boss occlusion and depth terrain use only scene depth tightly matched against the hunter and distinct from its clear value, otherwise the boss remains visible and uses MHW's surface ray for grounding
rows.test: screenshot shows the intro over MHW title/hub; depth diagnostics compare scene samples at Present and immediately before the next clear; a near-clear sample does not validate; in a live hunt the boss remains stable and World terrain hides the covered pixels while it follows MHW's surface ray

rows.summary: per-frame game-thread work via sMhCamera object vptr swapped to a copied vtable (no code patch)
rows.test: log: tick rate ~60/s in hunt

rows.summary: r2read resolves Remnant II content from the player's install; bosses use per-material base-colour and tangent-space normal maps up to 4096px, with MHW scene lighting and ambient shadow fill
rows.trigger: UI needs catalog data or a Remnant boss is rendered
rows.test: all referenced boss meshes, skeletons, base-colour textures and normal maps resolve; active boss texture logs show the highest available mip up to 4096px and no FAILED assets; a live MHW scene shows visible texture detail and no crushed-black body shading

rows.summary: knows base (Astera/Seliana/hubs) vs hunt from the zone id
rows.test: log: zone changes on travel

rows.summary: Remnant combat runs only when the hunter is alone in the quest (v0.1); co-op later
rows.test: log: solo=1 in a solo quest

rows.summary: toggle Remnant gun mode; keep the hunter visible in third person, retarget Remnant's nine-way aim poses onto the same hunter arm/hand skeleton, attach the gun to its posed right hand and align the barrel to camera aim; block MHW attack inputs while active
rows.test: B toggles the gun; a live screenshot shows the existing hunter aiming the Remnant gun with both hands in third person and the barrel on the camera aim line during idle, aim, reload and a Remnant skill; no guessed joint placement, floating gun or detached hands; MHW attack does not fire while active

rows.summary: hitscan from camera along view; first monster OBB hit takes damage (weakspot = upper third of box), monster notices via a slinger shell, damage number shown
rows.test: monster HP drops by sheet damage x mults; damage number appears

rows.summary: R or empty mag refills from reserve over reload_s x archetype reload_mult
rows.test: ammo counter refills after reload_s

rows.summary: mouse wheel / X swaps long gun and hand gun
rows.test: hud shows other gun icon

rows.summary: damage dealt fills the long gun's mod meter; F activates the mod
rows.test: meter fills at charge_damage; effect applies

rows.summary: the skill key activates the archetype skill and retargets its Remnant animation onto the existing MHW hunter arm and hand joints; no separate Remnant player body is drawn
rows.test: each effect measurable in HP log; a live screenshot shows the existing hunter's arms and hands perform the Remnant pose without detached or duplicate limbs or a held Remnant item leaving the hands

rows.summary: Remnant boss hits use the hunter's World health manager; a lethal hit must enter World's real faint and camp return path. Until that path is verified, the hunter must never be left alive at zero health. An action animation alone does not count as a faint.
rows.test: in a live hunt, a lethal Remnant boss hit plays World's faint, returns the hunter to camp, and applies the quest's faint count; if the native handoff is unavailable the hunter stays at one health rather than alive at zero

rows.summary: turns MHW-weapon hits and monster hits into Remnant effects by watching HP deltas each tick (no damage hook)
rows.test: Juggernaut refunds part of damage taken

rows.summary: V uses a Dragon Heart charge: heals heal_pct of max HP over heal_over_s
rows.test: HP rises, charge count drops

rows.summary: charges refill on returning to base/camp or opening the Item Box menu at a base/camp location away from known NPC service points
rows.trigger: base/camp zone change or rising edge of the MHW menu-open signal away from known NPC service points
rows.test: charges full after returning to Astera or opening the Item Box; no repeat refill while menu stays open, and no refill from known NPC service menus

rows.summary: Remnant currency: earned from damage dealt to large monsters and quest completion
rows.test: scrap rises during a hunt

rows.summary: Brabus sells guns for scrap; McCabe upgrades the equipped long gun
rows.test: buy updates inventory; upgrade raises damage

rows.summary: mod state (archetype, guns owned, upgrades, scrap, relic) saved per Steam user in %LOCALAPPDATA%/RemnantHunt/save.json
rows.test: state survives a restart

rows.summary: first launch shows intro then archetype select; can be reopened from the terminal
rows.test: fresh save shows intro once
